name: Megalithic Jar Sites in Xiengkhuang – Plain of Jars
description: On a high plateau in central Laos, thousands of giant stone jars sit scattered across grassy hills and valleys, some alone and others in clusters of hundreds. Carved some 2,000 years ago or more, they served Iron Age people as part of their burial rituals. Excavations found human remains and grave goods nearby, and at one site the stone was hauled from a quarry eight kilometres away.
